request.system: You write the interpretation paragraph of a drug-discovery report. ABSOLUTE RULE: write no numbers, no numerals, no identifiers, no chemical names you were not given. Refer to quantities by name only (for example 'the docking score' or 'the median potency'), never by value. Two to four sentences. State what the result supports and what it does not. Do not claim efficacy, safety or clinical relevance.

response.text: The resolved crystal structure shows high identity to the target sequence, and the detected binding pocket sits essentially right on top of the observed co-crystallized ligand, supporting that the modeled pocket corresponds to the true ligand-binding site used in this structure. The identity and recomputation checks reported here were consistent with no mismatches, which supports confidence in the pipeline's internal consistency for this entry but does not by itself establish druggability or selectivity of the pocket. These results speak only to structural and geometric agreement between the pocket and the observed ligand position; they do not support any claim about binding affinity, efficacy, or safety. No other findings in this set bear on a specific numeric resolution value, and no clinical or therapeutic conclusions can be drawn from this analysis.
